name: Nikya
description: Centaur leader of the Zhur-Taa Clan, who bottlenecked the Golgari with constricting vine magic.

description_citations.text: "Gruul Clans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Gruul shaman from Nikya's clan comes to take Zi back, but Cecilee refuses, and the Gruul begin attacking the Selesnyans.
timeline.quote: After Cecilee adopted Zi, the Gruul sent a woman to take him back.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: With Bolas's help Domri defeats Borborygmos and becomes Gruul guildmaster.
timeline.quote: becoming the guildmaster by defeating the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rallies the Zhur-Taa and burns the Azorius South Records Hall after stealing documents on Massacre Girl.
timeline.quote: Ruzi later broke into the Azorius South Records Hall and escaped with documents relating to Massacre Girl, before setting the building alight.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gruul Zhur-Taa warriors attack Massacre Girl's Rakdos party; Kal's Izzet spell decimates her forces and she retreats from the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Massacre Girl herself survived the battle and retreated from the Rubblebelt following this incident.

citation.text: "Massacre Girl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gruul fight in Ravnica's defense in the Phyrexian invasion; Borborygmos gains respect and Nikya blocks the Golgari from the surface.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos' ferocious fighting earned him even more respect and loyalty.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
